--                status: queued | running | waiting_approval | succeeded | failed | cancelled

p-latest-step-of-every-run.reference:

p-two-slowest-tool-calls-per-agent.starter:
-- Tables (PostgreSQL; time zone UTC):
--   runs         (id, tenant, agent, status, started_at timestamptz, finished_at, input jsonb)
--                status: queued | running | waiting_approval | succeeded | failed | cancelled
--   steps        (run_id -> runs, seq, kind, name, status, started_at, duration_ms, tokens)  -- kind: llm | tool | approval
--   audit_events (id, actor, action, at timestamptz)
--
-- Return: agent, run_id, name, duration_ms.
-- Order: agents alphabetically, slowest first within each agent.

-- Write your query here.
p-two-slowest-tool-calls-per-agent.reference:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT r.agent, s.run_id, s.name, s.duration_ms,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.agent ORDER BY s.duration_ms DESC) AS rn
  FROM steps s JOIN runs r ON r.id = s.run_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'tool'
)
SELECT agent, run_id, name, duration_ms FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY agent, rn

p-success-rate-per-agent.starter:
-- Tables (PostgreSQL; time zone UTC):
--   runs         (id, tenant, agent, status, started_at timestamptz, finished_at, input jsonb)
--                status: queued | running | waiting_approval | succeeded | failed | cancelled
--   steps        (run_id -> runs, seq, kind, name, status, started_at, duration_ms, tokens)  -- kind: llm | tool | approval
--   audit_events (id, actor, action, at timestamptz)
--
-- Return: agent, total, finished, success_pct (rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when nothing has finished).
-- Order: any (rows are compared as a set).

-- Write your query here.
p-success-rate-per-agent.reference:
SELECT agent,
       count(*) AS total,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')) AS finished,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'succeeded')
             / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')), 0), 1) AS success_pct
FROM runs
GROUP BY agent
ORDER BY agent

p-find-gaps-in-step-numbering.starter:
-- Tables (PostgreSQL; time zone UTC):
--   runs         (id, tenant, agent, status, started_at timestamptz, finished_at, input jsonb)
--                status: queued | running | waiting_approval | succeeded | failed | cancelled
--   steps        (run_id -> runs, seq, kind, name, status, started_at, duration_ms, tokens)  -- kind: llm | tool | approval
--   audit_events (id, actor, action, at timestamptz)
--
-- Return: run_id, gap_start, gap_end.
-- Order: any (rows are compared as a set).

-- Write your query here.
p-find-gaps-in-step-numbering.reference:
SELECT run_id, seq + 1 AS gap_start, next_seq - 1 AS gap_end
FROM (SELECT run_id, seq, LEAD(seq) OVER (PARTITION BY run_id ORDER BY seq) AS next_seq FROM steps) t
WHERE next_seq > seq + 1
ORDER BY run_id, gap_start
p-find-gaps-in-step-numbering.solution:

ORDER BY run_id, gap_start

p-group-operator-activity-into-sessions.starter:
-- Tables (PostgreSQL; time zone UTC):
--   runs         (id, tenant, agent, status, started_at timestamptz, finished_at, input jsonb)
--                status: queued | running | waiting_approval | succeeded | failed | cancelled
--   steps        (run_id -> runs, seq, kind, name, status, started_at, duration_ms, tokens)  -- kind: llm | tool | approval
--   audit_events (id, actor, action, at timestamptz)
--
-- Return: actor, session_no, first event ('HH24:MI'), last event ('HH24:MI'), events.
-- Order: any (rows are compared as a set).

-- Write your query here.
p-group-operator-activity-into-sessions.reference:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT id, actor, at,
         CASE WHEN at - LAG(at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY at, id) <= interval '30 minutes'
              THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS starts_session
  FROM audit_events
), numbered AS (
  SELECT actor, at, sum(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY at, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT actor, session_no, to_char(min(at), 'HH24:MI'), to_char(max(at), 'HH24:MI'), count(*)
FROM numbered
GROUP BY actor, session_no
ORDER BY actor, session_no
p-group-operator-activity-into-sessions.solution:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT id, actor, at,
         CASE WHEN at - LAG(at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY at, id) <= interval '30 minutes'
              THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS starts_session
  FROM audit_events
), numbered AS (
  SELECT actor, at, sum(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY at, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT actor, session_no, to_char(min(at), 'HH24:MI'), to_char(max(at), 'HH24:MI'), count(*)
FROM numbered
GROUP BY actor, session_no
ORDER BY actor, session_no

p-daily-run-counts-including-days-with-n.starter:
-- Tables (PostgreSQL; time zone UTC):
--   runs         (id, tenant, agent, status, started_at timestamptz, finished_at, input jsonb)
--                status: queued | running | waiting_approval | succeeded | failed | cancelled
--   steps        (run_id -> runs, seq, kind, name, status, started_at, duration_ms, tokens)  -- kind: llm | tool | approval
--   audit_events (id, actor, action, at timestamptz)
--
-- Return: day (a date), runs started that day.
-- Order: any (rows are compared as a set).

-- Write your query here.
p-daily-run-counts-including-days-with-n.reference:
SELECT d::date AS day, count(r.id)
FROM generate_series(date '2026-10-01', date '2026-10-05', interval '1 day') AS d
LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.started_at >= d AND r.started_at < d + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d
p-daily-run-counts-including-days-with-n.solution:
